name: miromiro
description: Turn any live website into paste-ready code (Tailwind, HTML, React, Vue), an Elementor template for WordPress or a Shopify Liquid section, plus its brand colors, fonts, design tokens, SVGs and Lottie.

interface.shortDescription: Copy any website's design: code, brand, tokens, fonts, assets
interface.longDescription: Reads a live website's real HTML and CSS and returns a section as Tailwind, HTML, React or Vue code, an Elementor template or a Shopify section, plus its brand colors, fonts, design tokens, images, SVG icons and Lottie files. Sign in once in the browser; a free account includes monthly credits, no card.
